Review: Echoes of Tomorrow
In this fast-paced sci-fi thriller, a woman races to
stop disasters she foresees before they occur.
Chases, dazzling effects, and time-bending twists keep the
tension high. Director Maya Chen balances action and
sparkling dialogue, delivering urgency and humor.
Showing Friday at 7:00 P.M. at the Student Center.
